findings: Identity audit currently covers 271 source-bound entries across the core games and all eight supplied Rifts books. This remains a partial identity audit, not full corpus coverage or mechanical acceptance.
Remaining core child paths, supplement subpaths, other supplied books and supporting mechanical entries remain to be audited. Identity evidence does not certify numerical rules.
Unassigned entries require named content-ticket fan-out after the complete option/dependency audit. The existing Vagabond ticket covers only part of its required mechanics.

Mercenary NPC profiles include referenced Uteni, Dysasha, Raksasha, Brodkil, tattooed/witch/psionic paths and Dog Pack Wolf examples. Profile-to-existing-option reconciliation and full racial/template evidence remain pending; named personnel are not invented independent O.C.C.s.

Remaining South America 2 occupation adaptations, heritage variants and referenced magic/augmentation systems need full dependency and named content-ticket review. Destroyer Borg remains blocked by the verified damaged page.

Powers Unlimited 2 category and named creation-branch identities are audited. Its genetic options, mental disciplines, weapon specialties, powers and other supporting mechanics still need complete dependency review and content-ticket fan-out; remaining Heroes books stay pending.
